# Buy Land In Peru

> Lucas, a US and Peruvian citizen living on his own land outside Lamas, San Martín, helps people abroad find, check, and buy property in Peru.

Buy Land In Peru is a personal service, not a law firm and not a brokerage listing site. Lucas scouts property on the ground, checks how a deal is actually held, and coordinates a closing through a licensed Peruvian notary and SUNARP registration. He does not hold the buyer's purchase money or take title. Site content is general information from his experience, not legal, tax, or investment advice. Property values and listings can change.

Contact: Lucas@BuyLandInPeru.com
Location: Lamas, San Martín, Peru
Service starting points described on the site: help with a known small plot from $500, a full search from $1,000, start-to-finish help from $2,000. The fee for a specific purchase is agreed in writing.
